Task: Display Indent Subject Name in Indent Draft Section
Query / Issue: Users could not see the indent subject line in the drafts table, only the generic indent type.
Solution / Resolution: Replaced the redundant "Indent Type" column with the "Subject Name" column in the draft list view.

Task: Route Emergency Work Order (WO_EMG) Indents Directly to Store Section
Query / Issue: Emergency Work Order indents were not appearing in the Store section after approval.
Solution / Resolution: Updated the approval routing logic: any indent flagged as `PO_EMG` (Emergency Purchase Order) or `WO_EMG` (Emergency Work Order) now routes directly to the Store section upon approval.

Task: Mandatory Remarks Field for Indent Forwarding and Reverting
Query / Issue: Reviewers and approvers had no provision to add remarks or explanations when transferring or reverting an indent.
Solution / Resolution: Integrated a dedicated remarks textbox and enforced validation during transfer and revert actions.

Task: Display Remarks on GRN Print Receipt
Page / Area: Goods Receipt Note (GRN) Print / Report View
Query / Issue: Reviewer/Store remarks were missing from the physical and PDF GRN printouts.
Solution / Resolution: Added a dedicated "Remarks" row in the GRN print report template dynamically populated from the database upon clicking Print.

Task: Fix Duplicate Payment Settlements Caused by Reverted GRN Redundancy
Query / Issue: Duplicate payment entries were displaying across settlement queues due to duplicate GRN records being created upon resubmission.
Solution / Resolution: Resolved by fixing the root-cause GRN revert process (deleting associated records from `payments_approved` during revert), which automatically eliminated duplicate payment requests.

Task: Restrict Submission of Empty Indents (Indents with Zero Items)
Query / Issue: The system allowed users to submit blank indents containing no line items.
Solution / Resolution: Added pre-submission validation logic and dynamically hid/disabled the "Submit Indent" button whenever the item count is zero.

Task: Implement Section-Level Unified Indent Tracker
Query / Issue: Department and section staff lacked a centralized dashboard to monitor indents across all institutions simultaneously, forcing them to authenticate into each institute account separately to check approval status.
Solution / Resolution: Developed a dedicated central tracker page providing aggregated indent visibility, current approval stage, and a complete lifecycle timeline across all institutions.

Task: Prevent Duplicate GRN Creation on Resubmission of Reverted GRNs
Query / Issue: Resubmitting a previously reverted GRN was generating redundant duplicate GRN records and orphaned payment requests.
Solution / Resolution: Updated the revert workflow to ensure reverted GRNs reside strictly in the reverted queue, and added cleanup logic to delete corresponding entries from the `payments_approved` table upon revert, eliminating duplicate payment generation.

Task: Enable Editable Specifications on Item Textbox During Indent Creation
Query / Issue: Indenters were unable to customize or modify item specifications from default master values because the input was locked.
Solution / Resolution: Removed the `ReadOnly` attribute from the specification textbox to permit freeform user modifications.

Task: Fix College/Institute Name Mismatch During Purchase Order Review
Query / Issue: When reviewing generated Purchase Orders, the institute/college name incorrectly mapped to a different indent record.
Solution / Resolution: Inspect query joins in the review page code-behind and add explicit `InstituteCode` (`ic`) and `sc` matching to ensure correct college name mapping.

Task: Feasibility Analysis for Multi-PO Vendor Consolidation on Emergency Indents
Query / Issue: An emergency indent comprises items spanning three distinct categories intended to be fulfilled by a single vendor, currently necessitating fragmented PO generation.
Solution / Resolution: Evaluate multi-select checkbox workflows with the engineering team to assess the feasibility of batching multiple PO line items into a unified vendor dispatch.

Task: Resolve File Upload Failures During Online Vendor Registration
Query / Issue: Mandatory registration files occasionally failed to upload/bind during form submission due to an asynchronous postback interruption.
Solution / Resolution: Implemented pre-submission validation at the code level to check file payloads before commit, preventing data loss.

Task: Provide OTP Verification for Vendors Post-Login (Follow-up from 12-11)
Query / Issue: Implement OTP-based multi-factor authentication for vendors upon successful credential verification.
Solution / Resolution: Mapped and listed vendors under the admin-side `Users` management page to support two-factor authentication provisioning, telephone binding, and OTP delivery dispatch.

Task: Integrate Rich Text Editor (CKEditor) for Indent Purpose Textbox (Follow-up from 11-11)
Query / Issue: When indenters format their purpose with bullet points or line breaks in the standard multiline textbox, formatting was lost upon saving/printing.
Solution / Resolution: Integrated CKEditor rich text control to preserve formatting, bullet points, and numbered lists into HTML storage.

Task: Enable Mobile Number Login for Vendors Without Email Addresses (Follow-up from 06-11)
Query / Issue: Vendors require an email address as their login identifier; however, several vendors do not possess an active email address.
Solution / Resolution: Created a dedicated configuration interface allowing administrators to toggle/select whether a vendor's primary login identifier should be their Mobile Number or Email Address, followed by appropriate database updates.

Task: GST Percentage Validation & Auto-Handling for Composite / Unregistered Vendors (Follow-up from 12-11)
Query / Issue: Input field failed to accept `0%` as a valid GST percentage value; Composite and Unregistered vendors are exempt from GST while only Regular registered vendors charge GST.
Solution / Resolution: Implemented auto-detection of vendor registration type upon selection. If Composite or Unregistered, the system locks and defaults the GST field to `0%`; user GST input is enabled only for Regular registered vendors.

Solution / Resolution: Discuss with the product team and stakeholders regarding adding a "Vendor Proposed Specification / Remarks" field to the item bidding grid and defining whether deviation alerts should be highlighted during quotation comparisons.
